title: Graciela Domínguez Nava Sworn In as Interim Governor of Sinaloa
detail: The Sinaloa Congress designated Graciela Domínguez Nava, a Morena federal deputy and former education secretary under Rocha Moya (2021–2024), as interim governor to serve the remainder of the 2021–2027 term following Rocha Moya's second indefinite leave. She took the oath of office at 9:00 a.m. on August 25, 2026, becoming Sinaloa's first woman governor. President Sheinbaum described her as 'a woman honest, a woman who has many years fighting for social justice' and pledged federal government support.
